scripts.setup: git submodule update --init && cd vendor/pocketjs && bun install --frozen-lockfile && cd ../.. && mkdir -p node_modules && ln -sfn ../vendor/pocketjs/node_modules/solid-js node_modules/solid-js && ln -sfn ../vendor/pocketjs/node_modules/opentype.js node_modules/opentype.js && ln -sfn ../vendor/pocketjs/node_modules/@napi-rs node_modules/@napi-rs && ln -sfn ../vendor/pocketjs/node_modules/bun-types node_modules/bun-types && ln -sfn ../vendor/pocketjs/node_modules/typescript node_modules/typescript && ln -sfn ../vendor/pocketjs/node_modules/@types node_modules/@types
scripts.check:platforms: bun vendor/pocketjs/tools/pocket.ts check --target psp && bun vendor/pocketjs/tools/pocket.ts check --target vita
scripts.test: bun test test/host.test.ts test/tcp.test.ts test/media.test.ts && bun test --conditions=browser test/sim.test.ts
scripts.test:3ds: bun run 3ds --pocket-only && bun vendor/pocketjs/tools/wasm.ts && bun test test/native-media.test.ts test/downloads.test.ts test/classic-art.test.ts test/search-pages.test.ts && bun test --conditions=browser test/dual-screen.test.ts
scripts.demo:3ds: bun run 3ds --pocket-only && bun vendor/pocketjs/tools/wasm.ts && bun tools/demo-3ds.ts
